America, Mumbai.
Unified Payments Interface (UPI) – Led end-to-end UPI platform delivery covering
backend switch integration, mobile app, and secure API rollout. Ensured NPCI/RBI
compliance (VAPT, OCs, transaction limits, dispute resolution) while enabling AutoPay,
UPI Lite, and Credit-on-UPI via SDK and QR-based merchant onboarding.
IMPS and UPI:
RAW file to CSV file Format: Streamlined transaction file processing by eliminating
redundancies and introducing structured headers and footers for better interoperability.
Migrating from ISO 8583 to XML: Upgraded to XML-based messaging enabling
flexible APIs, unified NPCI code, digital signatures, and future-ready ISO 20022
compliance.
NPT Remediation: Modernized legacy systems, databases, and hardware to strengthen
security, regulatory adherence, and operational efficiency.
SFMS Upgradation: Migrated to ISO 20022 replacing IFN298, improving global
interoperability and seamless integration with worldwide financial networks
Global Transaction Banking (GTB) - Implementation and Services – Platform
Managed implementation of Deutsche Bank's GTB platform (db-direct internet) for
corporate cash management across APAC, Europe, and America. Oversaw functional and
technical requirement changes, file format testing for Direct Debit and Collection files
(XML, SEPA, ACH/NACHA, NEFT/RTGS, CSV, IDOC, MT101, MT102), and ensured
customer readiness for DBDI and db-eBills processing..
Treasury management systems : Led application support projects to ensure smooth
business onboarding. Responsibilities included operational planning, impact analysis, issue
resolution, problem management, UAT, production release, DR and 24/7 support..
DBDC Migration from 6.5 ver. to ver. 8.2 : H2H file transfer application ensures secure
file transfers by configuring client profile, installation of SSL certificate, implementing data
level encryption and business rules. Connecting Clients to db-direct connect using HTTPS,
AS2, FTPS & SFTPI protocol.
CMS – Liferay & Alfresco: This platform serves as a portal for businesses to disseminate
articles with different access levels, facilitating the sharing of various documents. It requires
rigorous security measures to uphold data integrity and confidentiality.
DSR IT (Debts, Sales, and Research) project delivers RTB services to the client, aiming
to streamline the Electronic Trading System (ETS) using tools like Hobbit Monitoring,
ABFO, OTL, ORC & GL. It conducts regular health checks, addresses connectivity issues
between client systems and exchanges, identifies application bugs, and monitors server
processes to prevent failures and outages.
